prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right choice depends on your specific needs (hospital vs. clinic vs. med device vs. B2B/B2C), budget, services required, and desired outcomes. I can help you find the best fit. To get started, tell me a bit more about your situation — but meanwhile here’s a practical approach you can use right away.

Questions I need to know
- What type of healthcare organization are you? (hospital system, clinic, specialty practice, med device, biotech, payer, etc.)
- Primary goals: patient acquisition, physician referrals, brand awareness, employer recruiting, product launches, B2B sales, regulatory communications, etc.?
- Services you want: digital advertising, SEO, content, creative/branding, PR, events, CRM/email, marketing automation, analytics, clinical trial recruitment?
- Rough annual marketing budget (or range)
- Timeline / urgency
- Any required compliance/HIPAA experience?

How to evaluate agencies (quick scorecard)
- Healthcare experience: proven case studies in your subsector
- Measurable outcomes: conversion rates, CAC, ROI examples and KPIs
- Regulatory/compliance expertise: HIPAA, FDA, Stark/anti-kickback awareness if applicable
- Team & process: dedicated account lead, medical/clinical writers, data analysts
- Technical stack: EMR integrations, CRM/marketing automation, tracking & attribution
- Local knowledge: relationships with local media, referring networks, physician outreach
- Client references & retention
- Budget fit and transparent pricing
- Culture/fit and communication cadence

Key questions to ask prospective agencies
- Can you show 2–3 case studies with metrics for similar healthcare clients?
- What compliance processes do you have for PHI and clinical messaging?
- How do you measure and report ROI? What dashboards/tools do you provide?
- Who will be on our account and what’s their healthcare experience?
- What is your onboarding process and expected timeline to results?
- What are your billing models and typical retainer/project fees?

Where to look for candidate agencies
- Clutch.co and Agency Spotter (reviews & categories)
- St. Louis Business Journal / local industry awards
- LinkedIn for client recommendations
- Healthcare marketing conferences and local healthcare associations

If you want, I can:
- Provide a tailored shortlist of top St. Louis healthcare marketing agencies (I’ll research current firms and client work) — tell me your answers to the questions above.
- Or, if you prefer, recommend national healthcare marketing agencies with strong healthcare practice and St. Louis experience.

Which would you like me to do?
